name: App
usage: Root component of the application; wrap standalone pages or tests that need messages or confirmations

props.name: message
props.description: Global settings of messages. Only applies to the outermost App: nested Apps use the messages of the outer one.

fields.name: maxCount
fields.description: Maximum number of messages shown at the same time; beyond that, the oldest one leaves first.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Default number of seconds a message is shown (messages with "Undo" have their own default of 6 seconds).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Place it inside ThemeProvider at the root of the application; only components inside it can use useMessage
and useConfirmDanger. Messages appear at the bottom center of the screen.
